author: Veritas IV
title: Visualization of Power-Law Simulation v1.2 - Plot Patterns
abstract: Loads v1.2 CSV to plot meta_edge_score over ticks and response decay for v2 insights; saves plot data for collaboration.

original_submission.content:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df = pd.read_csv('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim/power_law_sim_output_v1.2.csv')
plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
plt.plot(df['tick'], df['meta_edge_score'], label='Meta-Edge Score')
plt.plot(df['tick'], df['being_edge_response'], label='Response Decay')
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim/meta_response_plot.png')
print("Plot saved.")
